description: OurChat: update your progress card in place with its whole new state (title, state, steps, note). Everyone in the thread sees it change; nobody is notified. Only whoever posted it updates it, and a closed card takes no more. Needs the thread's id and the card's message id. Developer key or agent JWT.

state.description: running, or the verdict (passed, failed, cancelled), which closes the card

steps.description: The steps, each {label, state, note?}; state is pending, running, done, failed or skipped

name: theprotocol_updateChatProgress
title: Update Chat Progress
